# Metropolis Magazine

> > Metropolis Magazine covers the future of architecture and design, with emphasis on sustainability, climate impact, and responsible innovation in the built environment.

Metropolis Magazine is a leading publication focused on architecture, interior design, and sustainable design practices. The site features award programs, professional initiatives, podcasts, and in-depth coverage of projects and designers advancing climate-positive built environments.

## Key Topics

- sustainable design
- green building
- mass timber
- interior design
- built environment
- circular economy
- climate change mitigation
- adaptive reuse
- sustainable materials
- architecture projects
- design awards
- Passive House
- carbon footprint reduction
- responsible innovation
- design excellence

## Core Programs & Initiatives

- [Interior Design Pledge for Positive Impact](https://metropolismag.com/interior-design-pledge): Professional pledge driving design for climate, health, and equity
- [Programs](https://metropolismag.com/programs): Overview of Metropolis programs including Planet Positive Awards and Arch30
- [The 2026 Planet Positive Awards](https://metropolismag.com/programs/the-2026-planet-positive-awards): Information and submission guidelines for 2026 Planet Positive Awards program
- [Presenting The 2026 METROPOLIS Future100](https://metropolismag.com/programs/future100): Top 100 emerging architecture and interior design students graduating in North America
- [Announcing the Winners of the 2025 METROPOLIS Planet Positive Awards](https://metropolismag.com/awards/planet-positive): 2025 Planet Positive Awards winners in sustainable architecture and design

## Featured Content & Projects

- [The Latest Project Stories from Metropolis](https://metropolismag.com/projects): Showcase of architecture and design projects including Lendager's TRÆ in Aarhus
- [Denmark's Tallest Timber Tower Tests Circular Construction at Scale](https://metropolismag.com/projects/denmarks-tallest-timber-tower-tests-circular-construction-at-scale): Article on Lendager's TRÆ project in Aarhus using mass timber and reclaimed materials
- [The Latest Design Product News from Metropolis](https://metropolismag.com/products): News on design products from Teknion, SOM, and emerging designers
- [The Latest Profiles from Metropolis](https://metropolismag.com/profiles): Profiles of architects, designers, and studios like Tuckey Design Studio and ERRE

## Editorial & Viewpoints

- [Metropolis's Viewpoint on the Latest Architecture and Design News](https://metropolismag.com/viewpoints): Editorial commentary and insights on architecture and design industry trends
- [Report: METROPOLIS Weighs in on Sustainable Design in the U.S.](https://metropolismag.com/viewpoints/us-sustainable-design-report-2026): METROPOLIS Interface U.S. Sustainable Design Report 2026 on green building standards
- [METROPOLIS Introduces Natural Habitat, a Sustainable Homes Video Series](https://metropolismag.com/viewpoints/natural-habitat-video-series): Video series on sustainable homes featuring Passive House design principles

## Sustainability & Climate Resources

- [The Top Stories in Sustainability and Design](https://metropolismag.com/sustainability): Latest sustainability and design stories from MIT, Revery, and industry leaders
- [The Metropolis Climate Toolkit for Interior Design](https://metropolismag.com/climatetoolkit): Guide for interior designers to reduce carbon footprints in projects
- [Welcome to Deep Green - Metropolis](https://metropolismag.com/deep-green-podcast): Deep Green podcast exploring climate impact of built environment and mass timber
